conversation.content: Can you help me understand the specific regulations and laws around starting a food business in my area?

message.content:
I can help — but the rules vary a lot by country, state/province, and even city. To give accurate, specific guidance I need to know where you plan to start the food business (country and, if applicable, state/province and city or county). A few other helpful details:

- What type of food business are you planning? (e.g., restaurant, food truck, catering, packaged foods sold retail, home-based food business, bakery, pop-up/market stall)
- Will you be preparing food on-site or selling prepackaged items?
- Do you expect to have employees?
- Will you be operating from a commercial kitchen or from home?
- Any planned alcohol sales?

If you prefer, I can also outline the typical set of permits, health and safety rules, and other legal considerations that generally apply so you know what to ask local authorities. Tell me your location and type of business and I’ll provide a detailed, location-specific checklist and links to the relevant agencies.
